name: SquareLaw.sum_fourier_eq_nextDatum
summary: γ is the conjugate Gauss sum divided by the number of matrices; apply `SquareLaw.sum_eq_nextDatum` to the Fourier transform of p̄ and compute the Fourier transform of the next datum with the matrix Gauss sum.

steps.claim: Take γ = conj(G)/#(matrices (T ⊔ N) × T) with G the matrix Gauss sum; |γ|²·|R|^{t(t+2n)} = 1 by the norm of the Gauss sum (`matrix_gauss_sum`, second part). For c, L, L′, p and h:
steps.lean:
(star (nextDatum p)) x * L (fromCols (inclMatrix R .inl) x) := ⟨star _ / card (Matrix (T ⊕ N) T
  R), by simpa [card_congr of.symm, field] using
  congr(‖$((matrix_gauss_sum (a := T) hψ hχ _ (by simp)).2)‖), @fun c L _ p h ↦ by
  rcases h.sum_eq_nextDatum (matrixFourier ψ (star p)), fun x y ↦
    (matrix_gauss_sum hψ hχ (L ∘ fromCols (inclMatrix R .inl) ∘ fromBlocks x
    y 0) fun g d ↦ by convert! h.left_mul (blockGL (1, g)) _ <;> simp [inclMatrix_inl]).2.symm
  conv_rhs =>
    enter [2, 2, x]
    rw [← x.fromBlocks_toBlocks, matrixFourier, sum_eq_sum_fromRows]
    simp [apply_ite, sum_eq_sum_fromCols, ← mul_assoc, ψ.map_add_eq_mul, ← sum_mul, ← mul_sum]
    erw [sum_addChar_trace_mul hψ, mul_right_comm, ← neg_bijective.sum_comp]
  simp_all [matrixFourier, mul_left_comm c, sum_eq_sum_fromRows (a := _ ⊕ _),
    sum_eq_sum_fromCols (N := _ ⊕ _), div_eq_inv_mul,
   ← mul_sum, ← eq_div_iff, card_congr of.symm, mul_comm (∑ _, starRingEnd _ (p _) * _)]
  simp [sum_mul]⟩

steps.claim: `SquareLaw.sum_eq_nextDatum` applied to the Fourier transform of p̄, and for each pair of blocks x, y the matrix Gauss sum for the function L(fromCols(1₀, fromBlocks(x, y, 0, ·))) (`matrix_gauss_sum`, first part), which transforms by χ under GL_T (the left equivariance of h, `inclMatrix_inl`).
steps.lean:
rcases h.sum_eq_nextDatum (matrixFourier ψ (star p)), fun x y ↦
    (matrix_gauss_sum hψ hχ (L ∘ fromCols (inclMatrix R .inl) ∘ fromBlocks x
    y 0) fun g d ↦ by convert! h.left_mul (blockGL (1, g)) _ <;> simp [inclMatrix_inl]).2.symm

steps.claim: Rewrite the right side: split x into blocks, expand the Fourier transform (`sum_eq_sum_fromRows`, `sum_eq_sum_fromCols`), and evaluate the character sum over the trace (`sum_addChar_trace_mul`, ψ primitive), with a change of sign.
steps.lean:
conv_rhs =>
    enter [2, 2, x]
    rw [← x.fromBlocks_toBlocks, matrixFourier, sum_eq_sum_fromRows]
    simp [apply_ite, sum_eq_sum_fromCols, ← mul_assoc, ψ.map_add_eq_mul, ← sum_mul, ← mul_sum]
    erw [sum_addChar_trace_mul hψ, mul_right_comm, ← neg_bijective.sum_comp]

steps.claim: Insert the Gauss sum relations and compare the two sides, the numbers of matrices cancelling.
steps.lean:
simp_all [matrixFourier, mul_left_comm c, sum_eq_sum_fromRows (a := _ ⊕ _),
    sum_eq_sum_fromCols (N := _ ⊕ _), div_eq_inv_mul,
   ← mul_sum, ← eq_div_iff, card_congr of.symm, mul_comm (∑ _, starRingEnd _ (p _) * _)]
